headline: A bus idles past the closed shutters.
body: The driver does not look up. Someone has taped a notice inside the glass, and the tape has curled at one corner. We note the time and leave the line where it is.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high cloud, the color of unwashed linen

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one scooter, then the ordinary quiet
